headline: Tencent's provider share slid 17.5 points in a day, yet DeepSeek still runs the provider table
summary: No records fell today, so the story is the provider shuffle: Tencent dropped 17.5 points to 29.2% of tokens and now sits second to DeepSeek's 32.4%. DeepSeek gained 9.1 points on the day to keep the top spot.
highlights: DeepSeek leads providers at 32.4%, up 9.1 points on the day.
The top two providers hold 61.6% combined, the top three 69.2%, the top four 73.1%, and the top five 76.7%.
tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 holds #1 at 29.2%, even as its provider's share fell.
Moonshot AI's kimi-k3.1-pro climbed 8 spots to #6.
Three newcomers: qwen3.6-35b-a3b at #38, mistral-nemo at #47, and particle-ai's particle-1 at #50.
Dropouts: tencent/hy4-20261104 fell out from #8, and thinkingmachines' inkling-2-small left from #50.
